profile_text.body:
Blender Foundation is a non-profit open-source foundation based around Blender, which it describes as free and open-source 3D creation software. The software covers a broad range of creative work including rendering, camera and object tracking, rigging, animation, and 2D drawing directly within a 3D viewport. Blender has a Python-controlled interface and supports community-built add-ons through an accessible Python API. The foundation notes that Blender is a member of ASWF, Khronos, the Linux Foundation, and OIN, and that it receives support from hardware vendors including AMD, Apple, Intel, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm.

On the AI side, the site tracks Blender AI Add-ons as a product category covering 3D creation AI plugins that are open-source and run with local processing, with model provenance described as varying by plugin. Blender 5.2 LTS, mentioned on the site, introduces a Cycles Texture Cache intended to make rendering scenes with many image textures more memory efficient. The foundation also runs an ongoing open production project called OVERGROWN, with publicly available production logs and a content gallery.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the Blender Foundation in the site's data.
